objects.name: Analytic 1718
objects.description: For Android, detect Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes privileged framework APIs (accessibility performAction, WindowManager.addView TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, PackageInstaller) immediately after acquiring elevation control mechanism without expected user settings navigation time]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved apps for each elevation mechanism: accessibility (approved screen readers), SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW (approved chat bubbles), INSTALL_PACKAGES (MDM agent, approved enterprise installer). Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 30s between permission acquisition and privileged action invocation. Legitimate use requires user to navigate settings before granting; immediate action post-acquisition is suspicious.
Banking, auth, enterprise apps. Elevation control abuse against these is high-confidence malicious.
